acceptance.canonicalization_algorithm: JCS_LIKE_V1: recursively normalize JSON object keys and string values to Unicode NFC; reject normalized-key collisions before serialization; UTF-8; objects sorted lexicographically by normalized key; arrays preserve order; version fields require JSON integer type exactly; separators comma/colon; no insignificant whitespace; LF only
acceptance.duplicate_gate: Derive the canonical-JSON semantic-core idempotency key before any write. A candidate with an already-observed identical key is classified DUPLICATE and produces no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack post. Best-effort repository search must show no existing proposed key before the first write.
acceptance.idempotency_formula: sha256(canonical_json_utf8({campaign_id,controlled_probe_name,current_blob,expected_version,next_version,object_id,prior_digest_sha256,task_id,transition_kind,wake_ordinal})); nonce, valid_time, transaction_time, verifier runtime metadata, and Slack metadata are excluded
acceptance.next_wake_requirement: If accepted, run X12_IDEMPOTENCY_STRATEGY_C9 wake 3/4 from CURRENT v34. Vary only the idempotency strategy probe, reject duplicate idempotency keys and stale expected versions, and do not claim database or cross-system transaction guarantees.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Event-first. After immutable event commit and exact readback, fetch CURRENT a second time and require exact version 33, projection digest fdd0dcbc31f3f843d08eaaa885e3bc8a161683c518507f639433ff73ef29b375, and blob 570a9e7c6af6a6ce5fbe7571541a05f09e1933a6. Replace CURRENT only using that exact blob SHA. Then read back CURRENT, the v34 event, and the v33 predecessor event and require exact latest-event, predecessor-event, prior-digest, prior-CURRENT, campaign-progress, and idempotency-measurement bindings.
acceptance.slack_post_rule: Post one sanitized pointer only after CURRENT advances to v34. A duplicate or unchanged transition produces no Slack post.
acceptance.stale_version_gate: Any expected-version or prior-blob mismatch must fail the single-file CURRENT replacement and must not be retried as an unconditional overwrite.

experiment.baseline: CURRENT v33 at blob 570a9e7c6af6a6ce5fbe7571541a05f09e1933a6; C9 idempotency_strategy 1/4; prior event digest 53031a8ca93c9f13410056ad2b6e2c5281e47d5bbf35729992ef7902a562a6e8. Wake 1 used a pipe-delimited semantic-core formula.
experiment.controlled_factor: Idempotency-key preimage encoding only. Replace the ambiguous pipe-delimited semantic-core string with a canonical JSON object. Retain event-first ordering, exact second CURRENT read, compact dual anchors, exact prior blob-SHA replacement, and sequential post-update triangulation.
experiment.exact_probe: Construct two distinct two-field semantic tuples whose naive object_id|transition_kind strings are identical because a literal pipe moves across the field boundary. Verify the naive preimages and SHA-256 digests collide, then serialize each tuple as canonical JSON and verify their bytes and SHA-256 digests differ. Derive the accepted v33-to-v34 key from the full canonical JSON semantic core, require zero repository matches for that key, and advance at most one transition.
experiment.honest_flaw: This is a bounded synthetic delimiter-alias specimen. Current production values are conventionally pipe-free but that constraint is not enforced by a schema, so the V1 ambiguity is real only under unconstrained string inputs. The V2 key still depends on one Python JCS-like implementation rather than RFC 8785 or cross-language proof. GitHub code search is best-effort, non-atomic, and can lag. The immutable event and CURRENT are separate commits and Slack follows both, so a crash can leave an orphan event or missing Slack pointer. GitHub's per-file blob-SHA guard does not provide cross-file atomicity, locks, linearizability, serializable isolation, database durability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side uniqueness, or automatic repair.
experiment.hypothesis: Canonical JSON encoding of a named semantic-core object preserves field boundaries and prevents delimiter-shifting aliases that a naive pipe-joined preimage cannot distinguish.
experiment.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If canonical-JSON semantic-core keying is later rejected, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only using that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA; preserve this alias specimen and reconstruct history from immutable events and referenced prior CURRENT blobs.

experiment.strongest_falsifier: The two adversarial tuples produce different naive pipe preimages; canonical JSON produces identical bytes or digests; the proposed key already existed but the search missed it; the same key advances state twice; an expected-version or prior-blob mismatch still advances CURRENT; event bytes fail digest recomputation; or final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree.
